Secure the phone beside you, outside your movement area, aimed at your side.
Start at the top of the push-up. Keep the shoulder, elbow, wrist, and hip on one side in frame.
Lower from the top and return to the top; that is one repetition.
Keep the shoulder, elbow, wrist, and hip from the same side visible together. Either side can be used.
If tracking stops, return to the top and keep that same shoulder-to-wrist line and hip in frame.
Tracking restored. Return to the top of the push-up and keep that same shoulder, elbow, wrist, and hip in frame.
Secure the phone in front of you or at a slight angle. Frame both your standing and lowered positions.
Stand upright and pause briefly. Keep both shoulders, hips, knees, and ankles in frame.
Lower from standing, then stand again; returning upright completes one repetition.
Keep both shoulders, hips, knees, and ankles visible. The illustration also shows your head and feet.
Before trying again, stand upright briefly with both legs in frame.
Tracking restored. Stand upright and keep both shoulders, hips, knees, and ankles in frame.
Secure the phone in front of you. Leave room above your head and on both sides for your arms and legs to open.
Begin with feet together and arms down. Keep your whole body in frame, including your hands overhead when open.
Raise both arms and spread both legs, then return to the closed position; that is one repetition.
Keep both shoulders, wrists, hips, and ankles visible throughout, with room for raised hands.
Return to arms down and feet together, leaving space for both hands above your head.
Tracking restored. Bring your feet together and lower your arms, with your whole body in frame.
Secure the phone in front of you so your standing body and lifted knee fit in frame.
Stand with both feet on the ground. Keep both shoulders, hips, knees, and ankles in frame.

Raise one knee, lower your foot, and return to standing; each complete lift and return is one repetition. You may alternate sides, but you do not have to; repeated lifts on the same side count separately too.
Keep both shoulders, hips, knees, and ankles visible, including the raised knee.
Put both feet down and pause briefly before the next lift.
Tracking restored. Put both feet down and keep your shoulders, hips, knees, and ankles in frame.
This guide explains camera placement and repetition counting; it does not assess exercise form.
